verdict.rationale: Statsig is a feature-flag/experimentation SaaS platform, not an AI agent or assistant that consumes external tools; the evidence shows Statsig ships an MCP *server* so other AI tools (Codex, Cursor, Claude Code) can query Statsig data, which is the opposite role from 'plugging MCP servers into this product to use their tools'. There is no evidence Statsig itself acts as an MCP client, and being an MCP client isn't a fit for its product category, so this axis does not apply.
